knowledge_gaps: Fault verification may be circular: both manifestation and detection use future-token response. Specify an independent injection oracle and a fault-to-probe matrix. Ensure probes exercise the altered execution path; a readout wrapper will be invisible to probes that gather endpoint features themselves.

Tolerance calibration lacks a reproducible rule, enlargement ceiling and failure policy. Calibrating against an unchecked baseline could normalize an existing defect. Structural index correctness should use an exact oracle rather than a floating-point threshold.

The assessment holds out users but reuses fault mechanisms. This measures generalization across examples, with limited evidence of detecting unfamiliar defects. Include distinct fault locations or mechanisms reserved for assessment, and distinguish per-user detection from per-mutant detection.

Thirty-two assessment users per category provide limited precision. Define interval methods, handling of zero alarms or perfect detection, repeated-mutation clustering, and minimum eligible counts before reporting reliability.

The pseudocode saves state after existing diagnostics and performs restoration checks only on successful execution. Protect the complete diagnostic call, specify exception behavior, and verify hook removal plus parameter and buffer preservation. RNG restoration alone does not restore a consumed loader or sampler.

The proposal changes direction from candidate-depth calibration to fault testing without specifying which existing probes it validates. It needs a bounded runtime allocation and a decision rule connecting findings to the fixed macro validation HR@10 objective. Originality 5 is plausible for integration; potential 7 remains speculative, and difficulty 4 may understate integration work without the actual model implementation.
